descriptor: An AI-driven job-seeker protection platform that tracks recruiter and vendor behavior patterns over time.

requirements.statement: The system must ingest recruiter interaction data from a CSV/XLSX file.
The system must display a dashboard showing recruiter interaction history to job seekers.
The system must highlight red flags in recruiter interactions for manual review.
The system must allow job seekers to manually verify data accuracy before displaying it.
The system must flag uncertain data for manual review without making automated judgments.
The system must provide clear explanations of displayed data to job seekers.
The system must ensure data is correctly attributed to the right recruiter.
Every screen the job seeker uses must complete its primary action in three clicks or fewer.
The system must not integrate with Gmail, Outlook, LinkedIn, Slack, CRM systems, or ATS systems.
The system must support manual data review to ensure completeness and correctness.
The system must display message frequency and timestamps in the dashboard.
The system must show whether replies occurred in recruiter interactions.
The system must allow job seekers to see responsiveness and follow-up patterns.
The system must ensure data is clean before ingestion.
The system must not score or judge recruiter behavior automatically.
The system must provide a trial period with real users to ensure reliability.
The system must gather positive user feedback to confirm reliability and ease of use.
The system must maintain a log of manual reviews for audit purposes.

releases.demo: Show ingestion of CSV/XLSX data and display on dashboard with manual verification process.
releases.goal: Establish basic data ingestion and display capabilities with manual verification.
releases.name: Initial Data Ingestion and Display

releases.demo: Demonstrate red flag identification and manual review process on dashboard.
releases.goal: Introduce red flag highlighting and manual review capabilities.
releases.name: Red Flag Highlighting and Manual Review

releases.demo: Show enhanced dashboard with message frequency, timestamps, and explanations.
releases.goal: Enhance data display with message frequency, timestamps, and user guidance.
releases.name: Enhanced Data Display and User Guidance

releases.demo: Present user feedback collection and trial period results.
releases.goal: Implement user feedback mechanisms and conduct a trial period.
releases.name: User Feedback and Trial Period

releases.demo: Show audit log functionality and reliability assurance through user feedback.
releases.goal: Ensure audit capabilities and reliability assurance through logs and feedback.
releases.name: Audit and Reliability Assurance

stories.title: Ingest recruiter interaction data from CSV/XLSX
stories.narrative: As a job seeker, I want to upload my recruiter interaction data, so that I can see it on the dashboard.
acceptance: Given a CSV/XLSX file with recruiter interactions, when I upload it, then the data is ingested into the system.
Given an invalid file format, when I attempt to upload, then I receive an error message.
Trust: Data ingestion is logged for audit purposes.
stories.task_guidance: Implement file upload functionality and parse CSV/XLSX data for ingestion.

stories.title: Display recruiter interaction history on dashboard
stories.narrative: As a job seeker, I want to view my interaction history with recruiters, so that I can track my job application progress.
acceptance: Given a job seeker is logged in, when they navigate to the dashboard, then they see a list of recruiter interactions.
Given a job seeker clicks on a recruiter interaction, when they view the details, then it loads within three clicks.
Trust: Every interaction detail view is logged with a timestamp.
failure_paths: Interaction details take more than three clicks to access.
stories.task_guidance: Implement a dashboard view that lists recruiter interactions with a clickable link to view details. Ensure navigation from dashboard to detail view is within three clicks.

stories.title: Manual verification of data accuracy and attribution
stories.narrative: As a data reviewer, I want to manually verify data accuracy and attribution, so that data is correctly attributed to the right recruiter.
acceptance: Given a set of recruiter interaction data, when I manually review the data, then I can confirm the data is accurately attributed to the correct recruiter.
Given a data entry with incorrect attribution, when I identify and correct it, then the system updates the attribution correctly.
Trust: Every manual correction is logged with the reviewer ID and timestamp.
failure_paths: Incorrect attribution is not flagged for review.
Reviewer ID is not logged with corrections.
stories.task_guidance: Implement a manual review interface that allows data reviewers to verify and correct recruiter attributions. Ensure that each correction is logged with the reviewer ID and timestamp.

stories.title: Highlight red flags in recruiter interactions
stories.narrative: As a job seeker, I want to see red flags in recruiter interactions, so that I can focus on potential issues.
acceptance: Given ingested data, when red flags are identified, then they are highlighted on the dashboard.
Given no red flags, when I view the dashboard, then no highlights are shown.
Trust: Red flag identification is logged for audit purposes.
stories.task_guidance: Implement logic to identify and highlight red flags in recruiter interactions.

stories.title: Flag uncertain data for manual review
stories.narrative: As a job seeker, I want uncertain data to be flagged for manual review, so that I can make informed decisions.
acceptance: Given uncertain data, when it is flagged, then I am notified for manual review.
Given certain data, when I view it, then no flag is shown.
Trust: Flagging actions are logged for audit purposes.
stories.task_guidance: Implement a system to flag uncertain data for manual review.

stories.title: Display message frequency and timestamps
stories.narrative: As a job seeker, I want to see message frequency and timestamps, so that I can understand communication patterns.
acceptance: Given ingested data, when I view the dashboard, then I see message frequency and timestamps.
Given missing data, when I view the dashboard, then I see a message indicating incomplete data.
Trust: Display actions are logged for audit purposes.
stories.task_guidance: Enhance the dashboard to display message frequency and timestamps.

stories.title: Provide clear explanations of displayed data
stories.narrative: As a job seeker, I want clear explanations of displayed data, so that I can easily interpret it.
acceptance: Given displayed data, when I view explanations, then I understand the data context.
Given unclear data, when I view explanations, then I see a message indicating further review is needed.
Trust: Explanation access is logged for audit purposes.
stories.task_guidance: Implement explanatory tooltips or sections on the dashboard.

stories.title: Collect user feedback during trial period
stories.narrative: As a product manager, I want to collect user feedback during a trial period, so that I can assess system reliability.
acceptance: Given a trial period, when users provide feedback, then it is collected and stored.
Given no feedback, when the trial ends, then I see a report indicating no feedback was received.
Trust: Feedback collection is logged for audit purposes.
stories.task_guidance: Set up a feedback collection mechanism during the trial period.

stories.title: Ensure positive user feedback confirms reliability
stories.narrative: As a product manager, I want positive user feedback to confirm system reliability, so that I can trust the system's performance.
acceptance: Given collected feedback, when it is positive, then I confirm system reliability.
Given negative feedback, when I review it, then I identify areas for improvement.
Trust: Feedback analysis is logged for audit purposes.
stories.task_guidance: Analyze user feedback to assess system reliability.

stories.title: Maintain a log of manual reviews for audit purposes
stories.narrative: As a compliance officer, I want a log of manual reviews, so that I can ensure audit compliance.
acceptance: Given manual reviews, when they are logged, then I can access the log for audit purposes.
Given no reviews, when I access the log, then I see a message indicating no reviews are logged.
Trust: Log access is restricted to authorized personnel.
stories.task_guidance: Implement a logging mechanism for manual reviews.

stories.title: Support manual data review for completeness and correctness
stories.narrative: As a data reviewer, I want to manually review data for completeness and correctness, so that data integrity is maintained.
acceptance: Given a dataset, when I review it manually, then I can identify and correct incomplete or incorrect data entries.
Given a data entry that is flagged as incomplete, when I complete it, then the system updates the entry accordingly.
Trust: Every manual review action is logged with the reviewer ID and timestamp.
failure_paths: Incomplete data is not flagged for review.
stories.task_guidance: Create a manual review process that allows data reviewers to check for completeness and correctness of data entries. Ensure that all actions are logged with reviewer ID and timestamp.

stories.title: Display recruiter interaction reply status
stories.narrative: As a job seeker, I want to see whether replies occurred in recruiter interactions, so that I can assess recruiter engagement.
acceptance: Given a recruiter interaction, when I view the interaction details, then I can see whether a reply occurred.
Given an interaction without a reply, when I view the details, then it clearly indicates no reply was made.
Trust: Every interaction view logs the user ID and timestamp.
stories.task_guidance: Enhance the interaction display to show reply status for each recruiter interaction. Ensure that each view is logged with user ID and timestamp.

stories.title: Show job seekers recruiter responsiveness and follow-up patterns
stories.narrative: As a job seeker, I want to see recruiter responsiveness and follow-up patterns, so that I can make informed decisions about my job applications.
acceptance: Given a recruiter's interaction history, when I view it, then I can see patterns of responsiveness and follow-up.
Given a recruiter with no follow-up, when I view their history, then it clearly indicates lack of follow-up.
Trust: Every pattern view logs the user ID and timestamp.
stories.task_guidance: Implement a display feature that shows responsiveness and follow-up patterns for recruiters. Ensure that each view is logged with user ID and timestamp.

stories.title: Ensure data is clean before ingestion
stories.narrative: As a system administrator, I want to ensure data is clean before ingestion, so that data quality is maintained.
acceptance: Given a dataset for ingestion, when I run the cleaning process, then the system removes or corrects invalid data entries.
Given a dataset with missing fields, when I run the cleaning process, then the system flags entries with missing fields for review.
Trust: Every cleaning action is logged with the administrator ID and timestamp.
stories.task_guidance: Develop a data cleaning process that checks for and corrects invalid data entries before ingestion. Ensure that all cleaning actions are logged with administrator ID and timestamp.
